tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
Upgrade your office communication with the Grandstream GRP2601P Basic HD IP Phone. Designed for small and medium businesses, this dual-line SIP phone delivers crystal-clear HD voice, 5-way conferencing, and noise reduction technology for uninterrupted calls. Equipped with PoE support and a dedicated RJ9 headset port, it ensures easy deployment and flexible connectivity. Secure, reliable, and manageable via Grandstream Device Management System (GDMS), the GRP2601P is perfect for professional office setups in Bangladesh.


Key Features:


  • Dual-line SIP support (2 SIP accounts)
  • HD audio with noise reduction
  • 5-way conference calling
  • Power over Ethernet (PoE) support
  • RJ9 headset compatibility
  • Centralized management via GDMS
  • Compact and wall-mountable design
